claim: On September 25, 2025 — four days after the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk — President Donald Trump issued National Security Presidential Memorandum 7, "Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence" (NSPM-7). The memo cites the Kirk assassination by name and identifies the "common threads" linking the violence it targets as "anti-Americanism, anti-capitalism, and anti-Christianity; support for the overthrow of the United States Government; extremism on migration, race, and gender; and hostility towards those who hold traditional American views on family, religion, and morality." It directs the Joint Terrorism Task Force to "coordinate and supervise a comprehensive national strategy to investigate, prosecute, and disrupt entities and individuals engaged in acts of political violence," the Treasury Secretary to identify and disrupt the financial networks of domestic-terrorism funding, and the IRS Commissioner to ensure that no tax-exempt entities are "directly or indirectly financing political violence" — with referral to the Department of Justice for any flagged organization.
